scope: 427 ordered entries: 257 locally imported tasks and 170 external link-only exercises; original trees unchanged.

modules.title: Primitive values and scalar functions
modules.entry_requirements: Start here. Read the TypeScript syntax for annotations, parameter and return types; use basic JavaScript expressions.

modules.title: Comparisons, conditions and unions
modules.entry_requirements: Use scalar functions from module 01. Learn boolean operators, remainder, if/else, literal unions and switch narrowing.

modules.title: Arrays, tuple positions and mutation
modules.entry_requirements: Use typed arrays and scalar expressions. Learn indexing, slice, spread, push/pop/shift/unshift, and the distinction between mutation and copying.

modules.title: Loops, string traversal and reductions
modules.entry_requirements: Use arrays, conditions and function returns. Learn for/while loops, accumulators, split/join and explicit empty-input policies.

modules.title: Interfaces and object operations
modules.entry_requirements: Use union narrowing and array methods. Learn optional/readonly fields, interfaces, index signatures and object property access; keep runtime key absence explicit.

modules.title: Reusable function contracts and safe input
modules.entry_requirements: Use objects, unions and branches. Learn function type expressions, callbacks, rest parameters, void/never, unknown and type predicates.

modules.title: Runtime composition and data transformations
modules.entry_requirements: Combine checked property access with loops and array operations. Learn shallow copy identity, nested records and explicit matrix assumptions.

modules.title: Classes, generics and discriminated results
modules.entry_requirements: Use functions and interfaces. Learn class state/getters, constraints, keyof, indexed access and tagged union exhaustiveness.

modules.title: Utility types, asynchronous APIs and declarations
modules.entry_requirements: Use generics, predicates, Result and callbacks. Learn Partial/Pick/Omit/Record, promises, async/await, overloads and ambient declarations.

modules.title: Type operators and basic tuple transformations
modules.entry_requirements: Use generics and keyof. Read indexed access, typeof, as const, mapped types, conditional types and infer before rebuilding utilities.

modules.title: Equality, distribution and special types
modules.entry_requirements: Use conditional types and inference. Learn distributive versus wrapped conditionals, never/any/unknown and strict type equality.

modules.title: Object type transformations and fluent state
modules.entry_requirements: Use mapped types, keyof, conditional selection and equality. Learn modifier preservation, optional keys, key remapping and accumulated generic state.

modules.title: Recursive tuples, collections and matrices
modules.entry_requirements: Use tuple inference, conditional termination and strict equality. Learn recursive decomposition and bounded accumulation; do not allocate enormous tuples unnecessarily.

modules.title: Template literals and string transformations
modules.entry_requirements: Use conditional recursion. Read template literal inference and intrinsic case conversion; distinguish character sequences from unions of characters.

modules.title: Function transformations and higher-order APIs
modules.entry_requirements: Use tuple transformations, generics, overloads and template literals. Learn parameter-list inference, recursive callable returns and higher-order inference.

modules.title: Deep objects, paths and schemas
modules.entry_requirements: Use mapped recursion, optional fields, unions/intersections and template literals. Distinguish paths represented by tuples from serialized path strings.

modules.title: String algorithms and structured parsers
modules.entry_requirements: Use recursive string decomposition and state accumulation. Learn overlapping matches, unique-character state, delimiters and nested grammar parsing.

modules.title: Numeric predicates and bounded arithmetic
modules.entry_requirements: Use tuple construction, recursion and numeric string representations. Separate magnitude-bounded tuple arithmetic from digit-by-digit arithmetic.

modules.title: Union algebra and combinatorial generation
modules.entry_requirements: Use distributive conditionals, intersections, recursive state and equality. Expect branching and combinatorial growth; compare unions semantically rather than relying on display order.

modules.title: Contextual this and constrained APIs
modules.entry_requirements: Use deep mapped types, callable inference, intersections and contextual typing. Learn ThisType and contextual object APIs before brands and diagnostic design.

modules.title: Recursive algorithm applications
modules.entry_requirements: Use recursive tuples, arithmetic state and nested data transformations. Translate algorithm invariants into types and verify all supplied cases.

modules.title: Compiler scale and advanced parameter constraints
modules.entry_requirements: Use all prior type foundations. Study recursion shape, broad versus fixed template patterns and optional/rest tuple intersections.

units.objective: Add nonnegative string, number, or bigint inputs and return a decimal string with carry handling.

units.title: Multiply
units.objective: Multiply the same input forms, building on the preceding arbitrary-length addition task.
units.review_note: Explicitly builds on Sum; digit multiplication follows digit addition.

units.title: Sort
units.objective: Sort natural-number tuples in ascending or descending order; retain large-number/float support as extensions.
units.review_note: Treat decimal/very large-number extensions separately from the core tested integer sorting.

units.title: CountReversePairs
units.objective: Count inverted index pairs with comparison and accumulation, including the supplied negative cases.

units.title: FizzBuzz
units.objective: Generate a string-literal FizzBuzz sequence efficiently for the tested bounds.

units.title: Pascal's triangle
units.objective: Construct Pascal's triangle with the requested number of rows.
units.review_note: Build Pascal rows with tuple arithmetic; keep recursion termination explicit.

units.title: Replace Union
units.objective: Apply an ordered list of type replacements to an input union.

units.title: Intersection
units.objective: Find values common to every supplied array, union, or individual type, returning a union or never.

units.title: Union to Intersection
units.objective: Convert a union into an intersection, including callable members.

units.title: Union to Tuple
units.objective: Convert a union to a single tuple without assuming an order or returning a union of permutations.

units.title: CartesianProduct
units.objective: Generate the Cartesian product of two unions as tuple alternatives.

units.title: Ordered modifier-key pairs
units.objective: Generate the tested two-key combinations in source priority order without reversing pairs.

units.title: Subsequence
units.objective: Generate subsequences while preserving the relative order of surviving tuple elements.

units.title: Permutation
units.objective: Generate tuple permutations from union members, handling never as the empty case.

units.title: Permutations of Tuple
units.objective: Generate tuple permutations without collapsing overlapping or special element types into a union first.
units.review_note: Retain absorbing any/unknown/never tuple entries rather than collapsing them through a union.

units.title: AllCombinations
units.objective: Generate all strings that use each source character at most once, including the empty result.

units.title: Combination
units.objective: Generate nonempty ordered combinations of words separated by spaces.

units.title: Defined Partial Record
units.objective: Generate the union of nonempty defined-property subsets, rather than a conventional optional-property record.

units.title: DistributeUnions
units.objective: Distribute unions through nested tuples and objects into complete structural alternatives.

units.title: Simple Vue
units.objective: Type a Vue-like data/computed/methods API with the correct accessible this context in each section.

units.title: Vue Basic Props
units.objective: Extend Simple Vue with constructor-based props and constructor unions accessible in each context.

units.title: Pinia
units.objective: Type a store with readonly getter contexts, mutable action state, and preserved method arguments/results.

units.title: Deep object to unique
units.objective: Distinguish nested structurally equal objects with type identity markers while preserving required assignability.

units.title: Unique Items
units.objective: Constrain an identity function to unique literal tuples and include the supplied element-level error diagnostics.
units.review_note: Element-specific error diagnostics appear as a bonus in prose but are required by supplied expected-error tests.

units.title: Tag
units.objective: Attach, inspect, compare, and remove ordered tags without breaking the required mutual assignability.
units.review_note: Tag utilities require ordered contiguous tags and consensus across unions, including any, unknown, never and nullable inputs.

units.title: Assert Array Index
units.objective: Design branded array indices and assertion narrowing with noUncheckedIndexedAccess enabled, rejecting tuples and indices from other arrays.
units.review_note: Use the metadata compiler override noUncheckedIndexedAccess: true; shared base config alone is insufficient. Branding is not runtime bounds validation.

units.title: InorderTraversal
units.objective: Return a binary tree's inorder traversal tuple, including a null tree.
units.review_note: Folder label and metadata difficulty differ; placement follows the traversal requirements.

units.title: Tower of hanoi
units.objective: Generate legal Tower of Hanoi moves for the requested ring count.

units.title: Sudoku
units.objective: Validate a completed Sudoku in the source's grouped-row representation, checking rows, columns, and boxes.
units.review_note: This Sudoku representation groups rows into triples; the later task uses an ordinary 9-by-9 matrix.

units.title: Valid Sudoku
units.objective: Validate the flat 9-by-9 Sudoku representation as a separate implementation and representation exercise.
units.review_note: Check boxes as well as rows and columns; a Latin square is not sufficient.

units.title: Length of String 2
units.objective: Count long strings with an approach that scales beyond a naive non-tail recursive character scan.

units.title: Length of String 3
units.objective: Scale string-length computation to the supplied multi-million-character generated cases.
units.review_note: Generated long-string fixtures reach approximately 8.4 million characters; this is a scaling capstone, not ordinary character recursion.

units.title: IsFixedStringLiteralType
units.objective: Recognize a single fixed string literal and reject broad strings, never, unions, and unresolved template placeholders.
units.review_note: Reject broad/open template patterns and unions, while accepting fixed boolean/null/undefined textual literals.

units.title: Parameter Intersection
units.objective: Intersect parameter tuples while retaining optional positions, variadic tails, and the longer input's remaining parameters.
units.review_note: Optional and variadic parameters plus unmatched trailing positions make this substantially harder than Zip.
